 Please Note: this position is camp based in the Bonnyville, AB area, working a shift of 14 days on / 7 days off with 10 hour days.

 Lead and participate in the construction of medium and high voltage electrical systems
 Perform substation steel erection, cable tray building, and cable trench, bus, HV equipment and steel structure installation
 Oversee the installation and commissioning of medium and high voltage transformers, switchgear, and associated equipment
 Handle cable installation for medium and high voltage power distribution systems.
 Terminate medium and high voltage cables, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards
 Interpret medium and high voltage electrical blueprints, schematics, and diagrams for planning and executing installations and terminations in construction projects
 Manage Material deliveries and inventorying of Materials as per the assigned work fronts, identifying any potential risks and bringing to the Site Supervisors and Foreman’s attention

 Comply with and follow Valard’s Safety Policies and Procedures and work with new hire employees to ensure they understand and adhere to Valard’s safety policies and procedures
 Address Crew any issues/Conflicts with Site Foreman as they arise
 Work with on-site Safety Advisor to address any safety concerns brought forth by crews and or Client
 4 years experience in the construction industry 
 Alberta Journeyperson Electrician certificate (Red Seal)
 Knowledge of various construction disciplines, safety regulations, and understanding quality control
 Demonstrated ability to read and comprehend blueprints 
 Comprehension of pertinent basic EB & G Principles and of lock out tag out procedures

Solution SFT cherche un (e)  Analyste en procédés et pilotage  dans ce poste vous interviendrez dans le cadre d'un projet client qui relève du secteur public dans la ville du Québec .
 Mode de travail : Hybride — minimum 2 jours/semaine en présentiel
 Activités et responsabilités : 
 • Prendre connaissance de l'architecture des systèmes, des stratégies d'implantation et d'essais, et du calendrier de livraisons.
 • Participer aux réunions de démarrage de chaque livraison et autres réunions du projet.
 • Consulter les utilisateurs pour définir précisément les besoins opérationnels relatifs aux dossiers fonctionnels.
 • Identifier les solutions possibles avec l'équipe informatique et rédiger une synthèse des solutions et de leurs impacts.
 • Présenter la synthèse des solutions et leurs impacts aux utilisateurs et à l'équipe — assurer la cohérence d'ensemble.
 • Valider les dossiers fonctionnels et remplir les formulaires d'assurance qualité pour l'ensemble des cycles.
 • Veiller au respect des orientations données par les utilisateurs par l'équipe de développement.
 • Élaborer des processus d'affaires pour représenter les solutions implantées (norme BPMN).
 • Agir à titre de PO ou d'assistant PO selon les besoins — rédiger et prioriser les histoires dans le carnet.
 • Produire la stratégie des devis d'essais et rédiger les devis pour les essais d'acceptation.
 • Réaliser les essais d'acceptation, assurer le suivi des anomalies et produire des états d'avancement périodiques.
 • Rédiger le bilan des essais et toute autre documentation requise.
 Biens livrables attendus : 
 • Présentation des dossiers d'analyse et des histoires (besoins, impacts, solutions proposées)
 • Registre des décisions et des points de suivi pour chacun des dossiers fonctionnels
 • Validation des dossiers de conception
 • Devis d'essais pour les essais d'acceptation
 • Preuve de réalisation des essais d'acceptation
 • Liste confirmée des cas à extraire — Scénarios pour le traitement des cellules d'essais
 • Stratégie des essais d'acceptation
 • Registre de l'avancement des essais par cycle et bilan des essais
 • Documentation des points de décision et des demandes de changement
 • Registre de l'avancement du traitement des anomalies / améliorations
 • États de situation périodiques
 • Tout autre livrable identifié pour le bon fonctionnement des essais
 Exigences de qualification :
 • Formation : BAC en informatique, administration ou domaine pertinent. Compensations acceptées : BAC autre domaine (+1 an) | Certificat dans le domaine (+4 ans) | Tout autre diplôme ou absence (+6 ans).
 • Expérience SI : 5 ans en développement de systèmes d'information en milieu utilisateur (analyse besoins, validation dossiers fonctionnels, rédaction devis d'essais, exécution d'essais), incluant 1 mandat dans un projet >8 000 j-p pour une intervention >250 j-p en environnement comparable à RQ.
 • Analyse de processus : 1 an comme analyste de processus opérationnels dans une grande organisation (500 employés ou plus).
 • Multi-unités : 2 mandats impliquant une interaction avec un grand nombre d'unités administratives.
 • Agilité : Expérience pratique d'au moins 1 mandat en méthodologie agile.
 • Essais d'acceptation : 1 an en préparation et réalisation d'essais d'acceptation en livraison continue.
 • Exigence 7 — BPMN : 1 an minimum en élaboration de processus avec la norme BPMN ou équivalente (Diagramme de processus, Diagramme d'activité).

At TC Energy, we are proud to connect the world to the energy it needs. Guided by our values of safety in every step, personal accountability, one team and active learning , we deliver the critical energy that North America and the world rely on while balancing reliability, affordability and sustainability.
 Join us. Connect to what matters.
 The Opportunity 
 Reporting to the Manager of Communications Operations, Brand & Governance, the Senior Advisor will work as part of an integrated communications team, with a focus on effective emergency response for the TC Energy External Relations department across Canada, the U.S. and Mexico.   
 This role provides oversight of the External Relations emergency management, preparedness and response program — strengthening organizational readiness and supporting communications during operational incidents, business continuity disruptions and other crisis situations.  
 Combining strategic communications expertise with emergency preparedness experience, the position will play a crucial role in the development of communications plans, training programs, exercises and response strategies that help External Relations effectively support the business before, during and after disruptive events.  
 In addition to emergency response responsibilities, the position will contribute to priority communications projects and initiatives across the team, providing strategic counsel, planning and execution support as needed.   
 The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, a dedication to continual improvement and consistent execution to protect and enhance TC Energy’s reputation. This role requires flexibility to provide support outside regular business hours when needed, including participation in the External Relations on-call program. 
 Note: We request all applicants to please include a cover letter at the beginning of their resume. 
 What you'll do 
 Lead and support the External Relations emergency response program including plans, initiatives, tactics and on-call administration to meet the needs of our teams in Canada, U.S. and Mexico 
 Lead and support priority communications projects and initiatives across External Relations, bringing strategic communications expertise to emerging business needs and enterprise priorities 
 Lead the development and continuous improvement of communications preparedness, response plans, tools and resources that support effective communications during incidents and business disruptions 
 Provide strategic communications counsel to leaders and business partners, translating complex business priorities into clear recommendations, messaging and communications approaches 
 Design and lead training programs, simulations and exercises that build responder capability, enhance preparedness and strengthen confidence during high-impact events 
 Develop clear, audience-focused messaging, content and communication materials for a variety of channels and audiences 
 Advise and coach responders and leaders to support effective decision-making, communications and coordination during incidents 
 Lead External Relations' participation in enterprise preparedness initiatives, partnering across the organization to strengthen response capabilities, enhance communications readiness and support coordinated management of significant incidents and disruptions 
 Coordinate and maintain on-call processes and resources that support effective incident response across the External Relations network 
 Execute governance to ensure annual training requirements are met for approximately 70 External Relations representatives 
 Monitor training participation, responder capability and program effectiveness to support continuous improvement across the External Relations emergency response program 
 Build strong relationships across Operations, Emergency Management, Enterprise Security, HR and External Relations teams to strengthen preparedness and support coordinated organizational response efforts 
 Advance new approaches, materials and tools to support the External Relations on-call team to improve their on-call experience 
 Maintain the program’s SharePoint hub, including site hygiene, information architecture, document organization and access to current materials 
 Establish and maintain communication governance processes, standards and tools to support consistency, accountability and operational excellence 
 Monitor, measure and evaluate communications effectiveness and apply insights to strengthen future strategies and approaches. 
 Minimum Qualifications 
 Bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, journalism, political science or a related field 
 6-8+ years of progressive experience in strategic communications, project communications, public affairs or a related field 
 Experience leading emergency management, preparedness, resilience or business continuity programs in a complex organization 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Demonstrated ability to manage incidents  
 Knowledge or certification in ICS 300 as well as ICS Public Information Officer or ICS Liaison Officer roles 
 Strong understanding of emergency management, business continuity and organizational resilience principles 
 Ability to support incident response as required during office hours; provide guidance outside office hours 
 Experience working with individuals from all levels of an organization, from field support to senior leaders 
 Ability to write materials and analyze situations to provide response recommendations quickly 
 Demonstrated resourceful problem solving when situations go off-script 
 Background in Safety or Security communications 
 Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 suite including OneDrive and Teams 
 Proficiency in speaking and writing in French 
 This position requires candidates to:   
 Be available for extended work hours outside of standard business hours 
 Fulfill weekly on-call shifts during the year 
 Occasional travel within North America

 We are a leader in North American energy infrastructure, spanning Canada, the U.S. and Mexico. For over 75 years, we have proudly connected the world to the energy it needs.  À Aviso, nous nous consacrons à l’amélioration du bien-être financier des Canadiennes et des Canadiens. À titre d’organisation de gestion de patrimoine de premier plan, nous nous engageons à faire preuve de leadership, d’innovation et de responsabilité ainsi qu’à miser sur le partenariat et la communauté. En travaillant avec des professionnels talentueux et énergiques qui incarnent nos valeurs au quotidien, vous constaterez rapidement que ce sont nos employés et notre culture « uneaviso » dynamique qui nous démarquent des autres sociétés. Si vous êtes à la recherche d’un emploi intéressant et stimulant au sein d’une entreprise centrée sur son personnel, découvrez ce que Aviso peut vous offrir en consultant le site www.aviso.ca/fr .
 L’occasion: 
 Nous cherchons à pourvoir un poste vacant d’une superviseure ou d’un superviseur bilingue, Nouveaux comptes, qui se joindra à notre équipe du Service des opérations, pour 6 mois. 
 Relevant de la ou du gestionnaire, Service des opérations, la superviseure ou le superviseur bilingue, Nouveaux comptes, assure la supervision de l’ouverture, de la tenue et de la fermeture des comptes sur diverses plateformes Aviso, conformément aux exigences réglementaires et aux politiques et procédures internes. Dans le cadre de ce poste, il faut fournir des conseils quotidiens, former et motiver le personnel, résoudre des problèmes et veiller à ce que les tâches et les responsabilités soient accomplies dans les délais impartis selon les normes de service.
 En tant qu’uneaviso : 
 Nous prenons soin de vous – Vous faites ce qu’il faut pour la clientèle, les partenaires et les collègues. Vous établissez des relations de confiance, prônez l’excellence du service et contribuez à une culture où chaque personne se sent valorisée et soutenue. 
 Nous osons – Vous remettez en question le statu quo au moyen d’idées audacieuses et de nouvelles perspectives. Vous accueillez le changement, recherchez des occasions d’innovation et êtes à l’aise avec l’exploration de nouvelles méthodes de travail. 
 Nous nous surpassons – Vous collaborez ouvertement et établissez des relations significatives. Vous recherchez des points de vue variés, partagez vos connaissances et travaillez de concert avec les collègues, la clientèle et les partenaires pour les aider à réussir. 
 Nous livrons des résultats – Vous assumez la responsabilité de votre travail, respectez vos engagements et vous concentrez sur la production de résultats concrets. Vous êtes responsable de vos actions et cherchez constamment à vous améliorer. 
 À quoi ressemble votre journée: 
 Superviser et coordonner toutes les activités du service pour assurer un traitement rapide et exact.
 Les tâches administratives du service comprennent l’ouverture et la tenue de comptes, le service à la clientèle, l’établissement des renseignements bancaires pour les TEF, les rapprochements liés au système, les lettres de bienvenue, la distribution du courrier, le classement et la numérisation.
 Gérer tous les dossiers de clients transmis à un niveau supérieur (interne/externe) et veiller au maintien du niveau de service à la clientèle au sein du service.
 Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité et faciliter la réalisation régulière de tests d’assurance qualité.
 Recueillir et analyser les principales mesures de rendement pour le service. Fournir des résumés de l’activité globale au cours du mois, en identifiant les circonstances uniques qui ont une incidence sur le service et les événements futurs prévus.
 Recommander des façons de simplifier ou d’améliorer les processus, s’il y a lieu.
 Maintenir une connaissance à jour de la réglementation du secteur.
 Mettre à jour les schémas de processus et les manuels de procédures conformément aux changements apportés à la réglementation, aux processus et au flux de travail.
 Surveiller la charge de travail du service et évaluer les besoins pour gérer les changements de volumes. Gérer les ressources en hiérarchisant les fonctions et en réaffectant les ressources afin de respecter les délais fixés.
 Offrir de la formation et un soutien continu aux membres du personnel nouveaux et existants.
 Fournir une rétroaction efficace et continue sur le rendement aux membres du personnel.
 Animer les réunions du personnel afin de faire le point sur les activités du service et d’encourager le partage d’idées, en sollicitant des sujets de conversation pertinents pour l’équipe.
 Requirements 
 Études postsecondaires et formation continue dans le secteur des placements, en particulier les fonctions d’un service des opérations.
 Connaissance approfondie des exigences réglementaires pertinentes; réussite du cours de l’IFIC et/ou du CCVM, un atout.
 De trois à cinq ans d’expérience dans le secteur des placements, avec des responsabilités croissantes, dont au moins un à deux ans dans un poste de supervision.
 Maîtrise (à l’écrit et à l’oral) du français et de l’anglais pour communiquer efficacement avec les partenaires, les clients et les collègues partout au Canada.
 Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles, y compris la délégation et le mentorat. 
 Grand souci du détail et de l’exactitude ainsi que compétences en matière d’organisation, de gestion du temps et d’administration.
 Capacité à travailler sous pression, à établir des priorités et à respecter des contraintes de temps.
 Solides compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes et capacité à gérer plusieurs tâches avec le souci du détail approprié.
 Compétences supérieures en matière de service à la clientèle avec la capacité d’identifier et de résoudre rapidement les problèmes à la satisfaction de toutes les parties.
 Forte motivation et volonté d’obtenir des résultats.
 Compétences informatiques intermédiaires dans MS Word, Excel, Outlook, Access.
 Benefits 
 Pourquoi Aviso ? 
 Chez Aviso, vous trouverez une culture dynamique et inclusive qui valorise l’innovation et met en valeur les réussites de ses employés.
 Quelques traits qui nous distinguent : 
 Un programme de rémunération concurrentiel qui récompense et valorise les contributions de chacun.
 Des prestations de santé, soins dentaires et une assurance de premier plan pour satisfaire les divers besoins de nos employés
 Des vacances généreuses, des bénéfices de santé et de conditionnement physique, des options complémentaires au congé parental.
 Des cotisations complémentaires pour notre programme de retraite.
 Un engagement à l’amélioration continue de notre personnel au moyen de l’apprentissage et du développement ainsi que d’un programme de soutien à la formation.
 Des événements sociaux organisés régulièrement pour favoriser le travail d’équipe.
 Vos renseignements 
 En soumettant votre candidature, vous consentez à la collecte, à l’utilisation et à la communication des renseignements personnels que vous avez fournis dans le but d’évaluer vos qualifications et votre aptitude à occuper un emploi à Aviso. Vos renseignements seront traités conformément aux lois canadiennes sur la protection des renseignements personnels applicables, notamment la Loi sur la protection des renseignements personnels et les documents électroniques (LPRPDE) et les lois provinciales pertinentes. Vos données peuvent être communiquées au personnel autorisé participant au processus de recrutement et ne seront conservées que pendant la durée nécessaire à ces fins ou conformément à la loi.
 Pour obtenir plus d’informations, consultez le lien sur la Politique de protection des renseignements personnels , qui se trouve sur notre page Carrières.
 Politique d’égalité d’accès à l’emploi 
 Aviso accueille et encourage les candidatures de toutes les personnes qualifiées, y compris les candidats/titulaires handicapés. Si vous nécessitez un accommodement, nous travaillerons avec vous pour répondre à vos besoins à toutes les étapes du processus d’embauche.
 Nous remercions tous les candidats de leur intérêt, cependant, seules les candidatures retenues pour une étude plus approfondie seront contactées.
 Aucun recruteur ou agence, s’il vous plaît.
 Aperçu de la société 
 Fort d’un actif total sous administration et sous gestion environ 145 milliards de dollars, et d’un effectif de plus de 1 000 employés, Aviso est un important fournisseur de services de gestion de patrimoine et de placement pour le secteur financier canadien. Nous bâtissons un écosystème complet de services de gestion de patrimoine à la fine pointe de la technologie et axé sur les clients. Nos clients comprennent nos partenaires, les conseillers et les investisseurs. Nous sommes un partenaire de confiance pour presque toutes les coopératives d’épargne et de crédit au Canada, en plus de l’être pour un large éventail de gestionnaires de portefeuille, de courtiers en placement, de compagnies d’assurance, de sociétés de fiducie et de courtiers remisiers. Nos partenaires comptent sur Aviso pour leur offrir des solutions bien précises qui leur procurent un avantage concurrentiel dans un secteur en pleine évolution et hautement compétitif. Notre courtier en placement, notre courtier en épargne collective et nos services d’assurance soutiennent des milliers de conseillers en placement. Notre gestionnaire d’actifs est Placements NEI, dont la spécialisation est d’investir de façon responsable. Notre service de courtage en ligne, Qtrade Investissement directMD, renforce le pouvoir des investisseurs autonomes, et notre service de placement entièrement automatisé, Portefeuilles accompagnés QtradeMD, est au service des investisseurs qui préfèrent une approche passive. Partenaires des correspondants Aviso offre des services de garde de biens et de courtier chargé de compte à un large éventail de sociétés. Nous avons des bureaux à Toronto, Vancouver, et a Montréal. Aviso est soutenue par la force collective de ses propriétaires : les centrales de caisses de crédit, Co-operators/CUMIS et Desjardins. Nous sommes fiers de propulser les entreprises qui renforcent le pouvoir des investisseurs. 
 Faire carrière à Aviso, c’est faire partie d’un groupe de professionnels talentueux et énergiques qui vivent leurs valeurs au quotidien, et appartenir à une organisation qui se consacre à votre réussite et au développement de votre carrière. Si vous êtes à la recherche d’un travail intéressant et stimulant au sein d’une société soucieuse de son personnel, postulez pour faire partie de notre équipe!
 Salaire 
 L’échelle salariale prévue de ce poste est de 83 000 $ à 100 000 $ CA par année. Les conditions de rémunération individuelles sont basées sur divers facteurs propres à chaque candidat et aux exigences du poste.

About Us 
 HarZa Group builds and scales direct-to-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves over 400,000 customers who trust us with their health and their money, and our newer brands extend that same promise into oral care and at-home light therapy. We ship primarily to the United States, run on paid digital channels, and have scaled 12x in a single year to nearly 150 people across 15+ countries. We are remote-first, async-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do.
 The Role 
 We are looking for a licensed dermatologist to become the medical voice of our brand: on camera, on the page, and behind the science.
 Our category is claims-led. The outcome we sell (healthier gum tissue, less visible recession, better skin quality) is not visually obvious in a three second scroll, and our customer is typically 50 to 70 years old and has already been disappointed by products that promised results. We do not win by showing a pretty product. We win by explaining a mechanism clearly enough that a skeptical person believes it, and by having a credible clinician stand behind that explanation.
 That is what this role is. You are not a passive endorser whose headshot sits in a footer. You explain the science on camera, you pressure-test what our copywriters write before it goes live, and your name and credentials travel with the brand.
 What You Will Do 
 Serve as the on-camera medical voice across paid social, advertorials, landing pages, email, and organic content
 Explain the mechanism behind our products (collagen biology, photobiomodulation, tissue quality with age) in language a non-technical 55+ customer actually understands
 Film short-form video content on a regular monthly cadence: mechanism explainers, myth-busting, objection handling, and Q&A formats
 Review creative, scripts, and landing page copy for medical accuracy before launch, working directly with the performance creative and copy teams
 Flag claims that overreach and propose accurate alternatives that still land commercially, rather than simply rejecting them
 Interpret existing research and help the team understand what we can and cannot say
 Be publicly named and credited as the brand's medical authority, including bio, headshot, and credentials on site
 Contribute clinical perspective to product development and positioning as the portfolio expands
 What We Are Looking For 
 Board-certified dermatologist (MD or DO) with an active, verifiable license
 Working familiarity with photobiomodulation, red and infrared light therapy, collagen biology, and age-related tissue change
 Genuinely comfortable and compelling on camera, with clear, warm, spoken English
 Willing to be publicly and permanently associated with a consumer brand, including in paid advertising
 Solid understanding of the line between structure and function claims and disease claims, and of FTC endorsement and disclosure requirements
 Able to work collaboratively with marketers: you understand that persuasion and accuracy are not enemies, and you can hold both
 Available for occasional live sessions within our collaboration window of 8am to 12pm EST
 Nice to Have 
 Prior experience as a medical advisor, scientific advisor, or brand ambassador for a consumer health brand
 An existing audience on social, YouTube, or podcast
 Publication or teaching record in dermatology, aesthetics, or light-based therapy
 Familiarity with direct response advertising and how DTC health brands operate
 Engagement and Compensation 
 This is an independent contractor engagement with a monthly retainer plus a content production component. Final structure is aligned individually based on credentials, audience, and scope of usage rights. Payments are processed via Wise on our side, and you can receive them in any USD account or wallet you use, including Payoneer, PayPal, or a USD bank account. As an independent contractor, you are responsible for your own taxes and local compliance.
 What We Offer 
 A fast-moving, remote-first environment where your input reaches millions of impressions rather than sitting in a deck. Direct access to founders and to the creative team building the work. A portfolio of brands in active expansion, which means the scope of this partnership grows as we grow. And a genuine commitment to getting the science right, because our customer base is one that cannot afford to be misled

About DataVisor
 DataVisor is the world's leading AI-powered Fraud and Risk Platform that delivers the best overall detection coverage in the industry. With an open SaaS platform that supports easy consolidation and enrichment of any data, DataVisor's fraud and anti-money laundering (AML) solutions scale infinitely and enable organizations to act on fast-evolving fraud and money laundering activities in real time. Its patented unsupervised machine learning technology, advanced device intelligence, powerful decision engine, and investigation tools work together to provide significant performance lift from day one. DataVisor's platform is architected to support multiple use cases across different business units flexibly, dramatically lowering total cost of ownership compared to legacy point solutions. DataVisor is recognized as an industry leader and has been adopted by many Fortune 500 companies across the globe.
 Our award-winning software platform is powered by a team of world-class experts in big data, machine learning, security, and scalable infrastructure. Our culture is open, positive, collaborative, and results-driven. Come join us!
 Position Overview
 We are looking for a Senior-Level Data Scientist to join our Fraud Detection team — someone equally comfortable building production ML models and getting hands-on with individual fraud cases. This is a dual-track role: you'll develop the machine learning systems that catch fraud at scale, and you'll personally lead investigations into how specific fraud attacks happened, reconstructing attacker behavior and turning case-level findings into trend reports and detection improvements. This is a great opportunity to grow your skills in a fast-paced, data-driven environment while making a real, visible impact in the fight against fraud.
 Key Responsibilities
 Machine Learning & Model Development
 End-to-End Model Development: Lead the full lifecycle of fraud detection features and models, from ideation and data exploration to prototyping, productionizing, and monitoring.
 Advanced Feature Engineering: Develop highly predictive features from complex, large-scale, multi-dimensional data, including user behavior, device intelligence, network graphs, and transaction records.
 Large-Scale Data Processing: Work with massive, noisy, and imbalanced datasets (billions of events) using tools like Spark, SQL, and our proprietary AI platform.
 Agentic AI & Automation: Leverage agentic AI to automate analytic pipelines and develop reusable skill tools that accelerate fraud investigation, feature generation, and reporting workflows.
 Live Fraud Investigation & Reporting
 Lead investigations into complex fraud cases across identities, accounts, devices, and transaction surfaces. Reconstruct attacker sequences and hypothesize actor intent and tooling.
 Produce clear, evidence-backed technical reports and case studies for product, engineering, operations, legal, and executive stakeholders.
 Generate fraud trend reports for customers, synthesizing case-level findings and aggregate data into narratives customers can act on.
 Qualifications
 Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
 3+ years of applied experience in fraud detection, cybersecurity, or a related adversarial/high-velocity risk domain (fintech, consumer payments, banking, SaaS, marketplace risk, or security research).
 Solid understanding of both classic machine learning models (Logistic Regression, Gradient Boosting, etc.).
 Hands-on experience with the machine learning lifecycle in a production environment.
 Investigator mindset: demonstrated skill in pattern synthesis, hypothesis testing, and triaging signal from noise in ambiguous, adversarial cases — not just building and monitoring models.
 Strong programming skills in Python (must-have) and proficiency with SQL; experience with PySpark is a significant plus.
 Experience with large-scale data tools (Spark, Hadoop, etc.) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
 Excellent communication skills — able to explain complex, ambiguous, or technical behavior clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including customers and executives.
 Professional proficiency in written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a global, cross-functional team.
 Base salary range: $120,000–$150,000, commensurate with experience.

About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.



Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.



Our vision



We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.



But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.



Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.



In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.



Our traction



Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com http://Owner.com website.



More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.



Our team



Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.



We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.



Where we work



Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!





About the Role



As a Strategic CSM, you'll own the full lifecycle for approximately 100 of our biggest & most important brands. These are the accounts where Owner's platform has the deepest impact. In an intensively competitive market a great CSM relationship is the difference between a customer who stays and grows and one who churns.



This is not a "check the box" CS role. You'll operate as a trusted business consultant for restaurant owners. You'll analyze their performance data, shape their marketing strategy, troubleshoot their operations, and build the kind of relationship where they call you before they call anyone else. You'll also help build the playbooks, processes, and institutional knowledge that make the Strategic motion repeatable as we scale.



We're looking for someone who thrives with a high volume of relationships. Who can handle the pace and ambiguity of a startup, and someone who finds real satisfaction in helping small business owners win.



What You'll Do



Own your book. Manage a named portfolio of ~100 parent restaurant brands. You're their person — the single point of accountability for their success on the Owner platform, from onboarding through renewal and beyond.



Be the consultant they don't have. Most independent restaurant owners don't have a CMO, a CTO, or a data analyst. You'll fill all three gaps — translating platform data into plain-language recommendations on online ordering performance, marketing campaigns, SEO, and guest engagement. You'll lead kickoff calls, performance reviews, and proactive check-ins that are grounded in their numbers and focused on driving results.



Protect and grow revenue. Own retention and growth for your book. Proactively identify churn signals using data points, intervene before problems escalate, and build the case for why Owner is driving real value. When a customer is considering leaving, you'll lead the save conversation with data and empathy.



Run business reviews that matter. Prepare and deliver recurring performance reviews for your key accounts. You’ll lead honest conversations about what's working, what's not, and what to do next. Tie every recommendation back to the restaurant's actual business goals: more orders, more repeat guests, more revenue through their own channels.



Build the motion. The Strategic CSM function is still maturing. You'll have real input into the playbooks, engagement models, and operational systems that define how this team works. If you see a better way to segment, prioritize, or engage, you'll have a seat at the table to propose it and the support to build it.



Partner cross-functionally. Work closely with Sales, Partnerships, Launch, Marketing, SEO, and Product to advocate for your customers and close the loop on their feedback. Escalate intelligently. Bring patterns, not just problems.



What You Bring



3+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related customer-facing role in B2B or B2B2C SaaS. You've managed a book of business, owned retention metrics, and operated with real accountability for outcomes.



Experience managing multi-location or high-value accounts. You know what it means to manage complexity across locations, stakeholders, and priorities — and you don't lose the thread.



A consultative, data-informed approach. You're comfortable pulling a report, identifying the story in the numbers, and translating that into a recommendation a restaurant owner can act on. You don't just present data — you interpret it.



The ability to handle hard conversations with grace. You've navigated cancellation calls, retention negotiations, and de-escalations. You don't shy away from conflict — you lean into it with empathy and clarity.



Strong prioritization instincts. With ~100 accounts, you can't go deep on everything every day. You know how to segment by risk and opportunity, manage your time ruthlessly, and still make every customer feel like they matter.



Comfort with a fast-moving environment. You'll work daily in Salesforce, Notion, Slack, SalesLoft, and Sigma. You’ll have 10-20 calls per day with customers. You’ll find problems you don’t have answers for but are expected to find them. You don’t have to be an expert on day 1 but you’re expected to be the person who hustles each day to get better.



Communication skills that flex. You can write a crisp email to a restaurant owner, lead a compelling business review, and summarize a complex situation for your manager in the same morning.



Nice to Have



 - Experience in the restaurant, food, or hospitality industry

 - Familiarity with online ordering platforms, POS systems, or restaurant marketing tools

 - Experience working in a high-growth startup where processes are still being built

 - Bilingual (English/Spanish) — a meaningful share of our restaurant partners are Spanish-speaking owners



What Success Looks Like



You'll be measured on the outcomes that matter most to our customers and our business:

 - Revenue retention - you keep your book healthy and growing

 - Customer engagement and product adoption - your customers are actually using the platform, and you know why (or why not)

 - Risk reduction - You proactively identify and reduce the overall risk for our strategic portfolio



A Note About This Role


We'll be honest: this is a demanding job. You'll carry a large book, move fast, and wear a lot of hats. Priorities will shift. You'll be expected to operate with high ownership and minimal hand-holding.

But if you're the kind of person who finds energy in helping small business owners grow — who gets a genuine thrill from seeing a restaurant's online orders climb because of a recommendation you made — this is one of the most rewarding roles in customer success. You'll have a meaningful impact on real businesses, real influence on how we build this function, and a front-row seat to one of the most exciting platform plays in the restaurant industry.



Compensation and benefits

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!




ABOUT NORTH:

North https://cohere.com/north is Cohere's cutting-edge AI workspace platform, designed to revolutionize the way enterprises utilize AI. It offers a secure and customizable environment, allowing companies to deploy AI while maintaining control over sensitive data. North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications.




WHY THIS ROLE?

Cohere’s team partners with Canadian public sector organisations to unlock transformative value through secure, ethical deployment of Generative AI (GenAI) solutions. We work collaboratively to address complex societal challenges while maintaining the highest standards of data security and compliance. You will work directly with public sector customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions using Cohere's stack.

This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how enterprises harness the power of AI in real-world applications. As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors.

We are seeking engineers with diverse skill sets, including backend, infrastructure, agent development, and deployments, who deeply care about customers and want to work at the cutting edge of Agentic AI.



Location: Ottawa (proximity to government customers), 20-40% travel anticipated.


Security Clearance: Eligibility for Active Top Secret clearance is needed for this position, candidates eligible and willing to obtain clearance will also be considered.

More information about Canadian Security Clearance can be found here https://www.canada.ca/en/public-services-procurement/services/industrial-security/security-requirements-contracting/personnel-security-screening/processes/security-clearance-request.html.



In this role, you will:

 - Build and ship features for North, our AI workspace platform

 - Develop autonomous agents that talk to sensitive enterprise data

 - Experiment at a high velocity and with a high level of quality to engage our customers and ultimately deliver solutions that exceed their expectations

 - Work across the entire product lifecycle from conceptualization through production

 - Lead end-to-end deployment of North in private cloud and on-premises environments, including planning, configuration, testing, and rollout



You may be a good fit if:

 - You have experience with and enjoy working directly with customers

 - You have shipped (lots of) Python in production

 - You have built and deployed highly performant client-side or server-side RAG/agentic applications

 - You have strong coding abilities and are comfortable working across the stack. You’re able to read and understand, and even fix issues outside of the main code base

 - You excel in fast-paced environments and can execute while priorities and objectives are a moving target




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. 


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs.



We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.



Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

Joignez-vous à la Banque Qui Défie
 
Être une banque traditionnelle n’est tout simplement pas notre genre. Alors nous relevons le défi de faire preuve de créativité en offrant des solutions bancaires novatrices aux Canadiens.
 
Comment? Avec une équipe talentueuse de challengers curieux qui savent s’adapter et remettre en question le statu quo. Si redéfinir l’avenir des services bancaires vous tient à cœur et que vous souhaitez le faire en ayant du plaisir, cette occasion pourrait être idéale pour vous.
 
Notre entreprise continue de croître : nous servons aujourd’hui plus de 800 000 personnes au Canada par l’entremise de la Banque Équitable, La Banque Qui Défie du Canada, et nous existons depuis plus de 50 ans. Join a Challenger
 
Being a traditional bank just isn’t our thing. Our team is made up of inquisitive and agile minds that find smarter ways of doing things. If you’re not afraid of taking on big challenges and redefining the future, you belong with us. Le Travail
Le Directeur régional adjoint Bilingue soutient la croissance du volume d’origination du groupe financement immobilier en identifiant, structurant et analysant de nouvelles opportunités de financement. Avec l’appui du Vice-président régional, Québec, il entretient, développe et consolide les relations avec les partenaires, courtiers et clients directs, tout en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes de crédit et de légal afin d’assurer le bon déroulement des dossiers et le respect des échéanciers. 
Le titulaire analyse et structure de nouvelles opportunités de prêts dans diverses catégories d’actifs immobiliers, évalue leur viabilité conformément aux paramètres de prêt et de tarification de la Banque, puis formule des recommandations au vice-président régional. 
Il participe à l’origination de transactions hypothécaires commerciales de plus de 10 M$, provenant de diverses sources de référence. Il prépare également les lettres d’intérêt (LOI), les accusés de réception des conditions (AOT), les résumés de crédit et effectue des visites de sites. Ce poste comporte de nombreux défis interfonctionnels et joue un rôle clé dans l’atteinte des objectifs annuels de volume d’origination du groupe financement immobilier. 
 
The Work
The Bilingual Associate Regional Director will support CFG origination volume growth by originating and analyzing new loan opportunities. With assistance from the Vice President & Managing Director, the Associate Regional Director will maintain, build and develop new partner, broker and direct relationships while working in collaboration with the credit and funding teams to ensure that the loan moves through the pipeline and meets timelines.   
The Associate Regional Director will analyze and structure new loan opportunities in a variety of asset classes and assess their viability in accordance with Equitable’s lending and pricing parameters, while making recommendations to the Managing Director.  
The Associate Regional Director will assist with originating commercial mortgage transactions greater than $5,000,000 sourced from various relationships. The Associate Regional Director will also issue Letters of Interest (LOI) and Acknowledgment of Terms (AOT), prepare loan summaries, and complete site inspections. This position involves cross-functional challenges and is integral to the overall success of the commercial group and BES in meeting annual origination volume targets. 

Les éléments essentiels de votre rôle seraient: : Avec le soutien du Vice-président régional, Québec, identifier, analyser et structurer de nouvelles opportunités de financement dans les différentes catégories d’actifs immobiliers commerciaux, tout en s’assurant que les transactions respectent les lignes directrices de crédit, les exigences de rendement sur capitaux propres (ROE), ainsi que les politiques et procédures de la Banque. 
 Lorsque requis selon l’exposition globale de l’emprunteur ou la catégorie d’actif, préparer le résumé de crédit avant l’émission d’une lettre d’intérêt (LOI) ou d’un accusé de réception des conditions (AOT), aux fins d’examen par le Vice-président régional, Québec et de présentation à la haute direction du crédit. 
 Promouvoir la marque d’Equitable Bank et du groupe de financement immobilier sur le marché en participant à des événements de l’industrie et des courtiers, tout en agissant comme ambassadeur auprès des courtiers, partenaires et clients. 
 Communiquer quotidiennement avec les équipes de crédit et de légal. 
 Gérer efficacement son pipeline de prêts afin de respecter les délais établis, en collaboration avec les équipes de crédit et de légal. 
 Effectuer des déplacements pour participer à des événements de l’industrie, rencontrer des clients ou réaliser des inspections de propriétés. 
 The core parts of your role would be to: 
 With support from the Vice President & Managing Director, the Associate Regional Director will originate, analyze, and structure new loan opportunities across the commercial real estate asset classes while ensuring that transactions are within the Bank’s established lending guidelines, ROE requirements, and policies and procedures. 
 When required by borrower aggregate or asset class, the Associate Regional Director will prepare the loan summary in advance of LOI or AOT issuance for review by the Vice President & Managing Director and presentation to senior credit management. 
 The Associate Regional Director will help promote the Equitable Bank and CFG brands in the market by attending broker and industry events, while being a customer advocate for brokers, partners, and clients. 
 The Associate Regional Director will communicate daily with the Commercial Originations team, and the credit and funding teams. 
 Responsible for managing their pipeline of loans to meet prescribed deadlines while collaborating with the credit and funding teams. 
 Travel for industry events, customer presentations or site inspections.

 Excellentes compétences en analyse de crédit.

 Excellentes aptitudes en organisation et en gestion des priorités. 
 Intérêt démontré pour le développement des affaires, la négociation et les présentations.

 Let's Talk About You! 
 Post-secondary education (diploma/degree) preferably in business or finance is required.

Job Description Summary 
Activités visant à prouver la validité ou la faisabilité technique d'un concept par l'application de méthodologies scientifiques et d'ingénierie. Le travail dans cette famille de métiers a généralement pour objectif de démontrer, par des tests ou des analyses, la performance et le potentiel de mise en œuvre d'un concept.
Le poste impacte les opérations du département et est responsable de la planification et de l'exécution. Ce rôle bénéficie d'une certaine autonomie, mais se concentre sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par des pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain jugement peut être requis, mais il est généralement exercé sous supervision.
------------------------------
Activities aimed at proving a concept to be valid or technically feasible by the application of scientific and engineering methodologies. Work in this family typically has the objective of demonstrating through test or analyses the performance and implementation potential of a concept
 Impacts departmental operations and responsible for planning/execution. The role has some autonomy but is focused on execution of activities within an operating discipline covered by standard functional practices and procedures. Some judgment may be required but this is typically with guidance. 
 Job Description 
 Rôles et responsabilités 
 Activités conceptuelles ou théoriques liées à l'étude/recherche et à l'application de l'électricité, de l'électronique et de l'électromagnétisme.
 Développement d'une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Utilisation de l'expérience antérieure et de l'expertise technique acquise pour exécuter les politiques/stratégies.
 Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs de réussite de l'entreprise ; utilisation de cette compréhension pour accomplir son travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre avec d'autres équipes et contribue au domaine.
 Utilisation d'un certain niveau de jugement et capacité à proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres établis, mais avec supervision. Utilisation de l'expérience antérieure et de la formation sur le tas pour résoudre des tâches simples. Accès aux compétences techniques et à la pensée analytique nécessaires pour résoudre les problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions.
 À ce niveau, le poste est probablement celui d'un contributeur individuel doté de compétences interpersonnelles avérées ou d'un leader débutant capable de recruter et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe.
 Développement de firmware :  Concevoir, développer et maintenir des logiciels embarqués temps réel robustes pour des relais de protection à base de microprocesseurs en utilisant C/C++.
 Collaboration multidisciplinaire :  Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les ingénieurs protection pour implémenter des algorithmes mathématiques complexes dans un code efficace et prêt pour l'embarqué.
 Optimisation des performances :  Optimiser les performances du firmware pour une exécution en temps réel, en se concentrant sur le traitement de données à faible latence requis pour les fonctions de protection et les piles de communication IEC 61850.
 Validation et débogage :  Tests et profilage pour garantir la stabilité dans des conditions de réseau extrêmes.
 Intégration de la cybersécurité :  Implémenter des pratiques de codage sécurisé et des fonctionnalités de sécurité au sein de l'architecture du firmware, conformément à la norme IEC 62443.
 Utiliser des assistants de codage IA pour la génération de code C/C++ embarqué, le refactoring et l'échafaudage de tests unitaires.
 Rédiger des spécifications/prompts précis afin que l'IA agentique produise des changements de code délimités et vérifiables.
 Valider le code généré par l'IA par rapport aux contraintes de temps réel et de mémoire.
 Appliquer l'analyse statique assistée par l'IA pour la révision de code critique pour la sécurité.
 Qualifications requises 
 Formation :  Master en Systèmes Embarqués, Informatique ou Génie Électrique
 Maîtrise experte du C et du C++ pour les environnements embarqués.
 Connaissance des principes de protection des systèmes électriques ou du traitement numérique du signal (DSP).
 Maîtrise de Python pour l'automatisation des tests.
 Connaissance de GitHub.
 Expérience avec les systèmes d'exploitation temps réel (VxWorks, FreeRTOS, QNX ou Linux embarqué).
 Langue :  Maîtrise de l'anglais ; le français est obligatoire pour la collaboration locale.
 Caractéristiques souhaitées 
 Expérience en conception basée sur les modèles (par exemple, MATLAB/Simulink Coder).
 Familiarité avec les méthodologies de développement Agile/Scrum et les pipelines CI/CD pour le firmware.
 Expérience préalable dans les secteurs de l'énergie, de l'industrie ou de l'aérospatiale.
 Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Capacité démontrée à analyser et à résoudre des problèmes. Capacité à documenter, planifier, commercialiser et exécuter des programmes. Compétences établies en gestion de projet.
   Poste ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap. Un référent handicap est présent sur chaque site 
 -------------------------------------------------
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 Conceptual or theoretical activities that deals with the study/research and application of electricity, electronics, and electromagnetism.
 Developing in-depth knowledge of a technical discipline. Uses prior experience and acquired technical expertise to execute policy/strategy.
 In-depth understanding of key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work. In-depth understanding of how work of own team integrates with other teams and contributes to the area.
 Uses some level of judgment and has ability to propose different solutions outside of set parameters but with guidance. Uses prior experience and on-the-job training to solve straightforward tasks. Has access to technical skills and analytic thinking required to solve problems. May use multiple internal sources outside of own team to arrive at decisions.
 A job at this level is likely to be an individual contributor with proven interpersonal skills or an early people leader who can hire and develop talent. Provides informal guidance to new team members
 Firmware Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust, real-time embedded software for microprocessor-based protection relays using C/C++.
 Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with Protection Engineers to implement complex mathematical algorithms into efficient, embedded-ready code.
 Performance Optimization: Optimize firmware performance for real-time execution, focusing on low-latency data processing required for protection functions and IEC 61850 communication stacks.
 Validation & Debugging:  Testing and profiling to ensure stability under extreme grid conditions.
 Cybersecurity Integration: Implement secure coding practices and security features within the firmware architecture in compliance with IEC 62443.
 Use AI coding assistants for embedded C/C++ generation, refactoring, and unit test scaffolding
 Write precise specs/prompts so agentic AI produces bounded, verifiable code changes
 Validate AI-generated code against real-time timing and memory constraints
 Apply AI-assisted static analysis for safety-critical code review
 Required Qualifications 
 Education:  Master’s degree in Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering.
 Expert-level proficiency in C and C++ for embedded environments.
 Knowledge of power system protection principles or digital signal processing (DSP).
 Proficiency in Python for Test automation
 Knowledge on GitHub
 Experience with Real-Time Operating Systems (VxWorks., FreeRTOS, QNX, or Embedded Linux).
 Language: Proficiency in English; French is mandatory for local collaboration.
 Desired Characteristics 
 Experience with Model-Based Design (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink coder).
 Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies and CI/CD pipelines for firmware.
 Prior experience in the Energy, Industrial, or Aerospace sectors.
 Strong oral and written communication skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Ability to document, plan, market, and execute programs. Established project management skills.
 For candidates applying to a Canadian-based position, the pay range for this position is between $92,300 and $142,000 CAD. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set. 
 Bonus eligibility: discretionary annual bonus 
 This posting is for an existing vacancy. 
 Additional Information 
 Relocation Assistance Provided: No

About ServiceCentral
 ServiceCentral builds the software that runs product service after the sale: warranty claims, repair authorization, and service execution, for everyone from the local repair shop to the Fortune 50 OEM. We have been doing it for 25+ years. We are Dell's Partner of the Year, two years running, and our products run service operations across 1,200+ locations in 100+ countries. We are backed by Valsoft Corporation, a permanent-capital owner of 150+ vertical software companies, so we build for the next decade, not the next funding round.
 The Role
 ServiceCentral is hiring Partnership & Growth Associates to win new customers and grow the ones we bring in. This is a real sales role from day one: you will build your own pipeline, run your own discovery conversations, deliver your own demos, and carry a quota. New business is the priority here, and prospecting is not something you fit around the edges of your week, it is the heart of the job.
 You will also own accounts outright, which means you get to see the full arc of a customer relationship rather than one slice of it: winning them, getting them live, growing them, and keeping them. You will build real product depth, get hands-on coaching from people who have done this work themselves, and have experienced support in the room when a deal gets complex. What we are looking for in return is drive, curiosity, and a genuine appetite for hitting a number.
 What You Will Own
 Pipeline generation and conversion
 Generate qualified pipeline through outbound calling, email sequences, and social outreach across assigned campaigns, verticals, and territories
 Sustain consistent, high-volume prospecting activity as the anchor of your week
 Manage and qualify inbound leads with fast, accurate follow-up and correct routing
 Research accounts and stakeholders so outreach is personalised rather than generic
 Run discovery conversations using our qualification framework, and deliver online product demonstrations
 Close new business against a quarterly quota
 Hand off opportunities above your authority to Specialists, Managers, or Directors with full context, and earn sourced-pipeline credit
 Route opportunities on the other platform to your counterpart owner, and earn referral credit
 Account ownership
 Own the full commercial relationship for your assigned portfolio of accounts
 Maintain a defined contact cadence so no owned account drifts without engagement
 Execute standard renewals cleanly and on time
 Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, closing the simple ones and pulling in a Manager or Director on the rest
 Monitor account health signals and flag at-risk relationships early, before they become recoveries
 Execute defined save plays on accounts showing risk
 Onboarding and time to value
 Own commercial handoff and welcome communications that set clear expectations
 Coordinate onboarding with Solutions and Support so customers reach value quickly
 Track time-to-first-value on your accounts and intervene when it slips
 Act on or route expansion signals that surface during onboarding
 Revenue integrity
 Audit subscription billing on your accounts to prevent revenue leakage
 Monitor involuntary churn signals (failed and declined charges) and drive resolution within 24 hours
 Reconcile the billing platform against internal records so MRR reporting is accurate
 Verify plan changes (upgrades, downgrades, cancellations) are executed correctly before a customer notices an error
 Surface systemic billing patterns to your Manager rather than fixing the same problem repeatedly
 Enablement and team support
 Provide day-to-day support on larger accounts held by senior colleagues: routine maintenance, data updates, configuration changes, and low-complexity requests
 Absorb repeatable work so senior capacity stays on new business and strategic pursuits
 Create and maintain customer-facing Knowledge Base and self-service content that drives adoption and reduces inbound volume
 Verify release notes for accuracy and customer clarity before publication
 Support go-to-market materials and campaign content for upsell and cross-sell motions
 Support trade shows and events: booth materials, collateral, demo environment readiness, on-site coordination, and lead capture with follow-up
 Systems discipline
 Keep CRM records complete and current, with a scheduled next action on every open opportunity
 Log activity accurately, because your forecast and your credit both depend on it
 What We Are Looking For
 Commercial drive.  You want to carry a number and you want to beat it.
 Resilience.  High-volume outreach means high-volume rejection. You need to make the next call sound like the first one.
 Coachability.  This tier exists partly to develop you. The people who progress fastest ask for feedback and visibly act on it.
 Process discipline.  You will run recurring operational workflows (billing audits, cadence management, CRM hygiene) that protect revenue. Reliability here is the foundation of customer trust.
 Commercial instinct.  You notice when a routine support question is actually an expansion signal, and you do something about it.
 Clear written communication.  Your emails, customer-facing content, and CRM notes are all read by someone who will judge us on them.
 Customer empathy.  You will handle billing disputes and pricing conversations. Doing that well protects both the relationship and the revenue.
 Curiosity about the platform.  The Associates who become Specialists learned their platform properly, not just the pitch.
 Autonomy and Escalation
 You operate inside a structured playbook with a clear escalation path. Escalation is a strength at this tier, not a weakness.
 Decide yourself:  standard pricing and terms, routine renewals, day-to-day account management within cadence.
 Escalate: 
 Any discount request, however small
 Any at-risk account signal, immediately
 Billing discrepancies above defined thresholds
 Growth opportunities in your accounts that need a Manager or Director, routed with full context
 Requests for non-standard contract terms, service commitments, or SLAs
 Quota and Compensation
 You will carry a quarterly quota weighted heavily toward new business, with expansion and renewal making up the balance. Quota is set from your assigned accounts and territory rather than a generic benchmark, and it ramps across your first two quarters so you are not held to full target while you are still learning.
 Compensation is a competitive base plus variable, with the variable tied to new business won, pipeline quality, and team performance. We will walk you through targets, weightings, and exactly how performance is measured during the interview process.
 Where This Leads
 Associate is the first rung of a four-tier track. Typical progression to  Partnership & Growth Specialist  takes 12 to 24 months.
 To be promoted you will need to show: 
 Two consecutive quarters at or above quota
 Clean, independent ownership of your named accounts
 Ability to run discovery unsupervised
 Evidence you have informally coached at least one peer
 Compensation and logistics
 On-target earnings: $130k CAD  (base ~$50-70k plus variable). Variable is tied to closed-won new business. When our MD or CCO leads the close on an enterprise deal, you share in the win for the pipeline you built and advanced
 Full benefits
 Remote within Canada, with working hours that overlap Eastern Time, where most of our team sits. 
 Some travel expected, predominantly within North America

Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.



But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.



Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.



What We Offer

 - Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency).  - Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

 - Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.
   
   


POSITION SUMMARY:

Trulioo is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead the architecture and development of high-throughput, low-latency back-end services that power our Document and Biometric Verification platform. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Engineering, the Senior Software Engineer will design and operate distributed, event-driven microservices that orchestrate real-time identity verification - ingesting captured documents and biometric data, coordinating ML inference and third-party vendor calls, and returning verification decisions at scale across multiple global regions. You will bridge the gap between developer-facing APIs, asynchronous processing pipelines, and the ML and infrastructure systems that sit behind them.



This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.



This will be a full-time, permanent position, ideally working out of the Vancouver office on a hybrid model (3-days per week in the office). However, we are open to remote arrangements for the right candidate. 





WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

 - Service Architecture: Design, build, and maintain secure, modular, horizontally-scalable microservices

 - API & Contract Design: Own the gRPC/Protobuf contracts that drive inter-service communication, and the REST/OpenAPI surfaces exposed to external clients, with versioning and backward-compatibility discipline.

 - Event-Driven Pipelines: Build robust, high-throughput streaming pipelines on Apache Kafka - designing topics, consumers, and stream-processing topologies to process transaction lifecycle events and coordinate downstream verification steps.

 - Data & State Management: Model and optimize data access across distributed NoSQL databases, search/indexing systems, and caching layers; design for consistency, idempotency, and retention/compliance requirements.

 - Workflow Orchestration: Implement durable, multi-step verification workflows using a workflow engine to guarantee reliable execution across service and vendor boundaries.

 - Performance & Reliability: Drive sub-second end-to-end verification latency and predictable throughput; tune coroutine concurrency, backpressure, and event-driven autoscaling across a wide range of load profiles.

 - Technical Leadership: Drive technical architecture, mentor engineers, and collaborate with Machine Learning, Infrastructure, and Product teams to deploy computer vision models and vendor integrations into production.

 - Leveraging AI:
   
   - AI-Augmented Engineering: Use AI coding assistants and internal tooling to accelerate service design, implementation, testing, and code review across the microservices platform.
   
   - Intelligent Pipeline Optimization: Apply AI/ML-driven analysis (anomaly detection, log and metrics insight, capacity forecasting) to continuously tune verification-pipeline performance, throughput, and decision logic.
     




WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

 - 8+ years back-end/server software engineering experience delivering production-grade, distributed services or platforms.

 - JVM & Kotlin: Deep proficiency with Kotlin (or strong Java transitioning to Kotlin) and modern JVM concurrency, including Kotlin Coroutines and structured concurrency.

 - Microservices & APIs: Hands-on experience building service-oriented or microservice architectures with gRPC/Protobuf and/or REST, including API design, versioning, and inter-service communication patterns.

 - Distributed Systems & Messaging: Demonstrated experience with event streaming and asynchronous messaging (Apache Kafka strongly preferred), including consumer scaling, exactly-once/idempotent processing, and failure handling.

 - Data Stores: Practical experience with distributed NoSQL databases, search/indexing systems, and caching strategies at scale.

 - Cloud Native: Comfortable operating services in a public cloud environment on Kubernetes, with familiarity around containerization, service meshes, and infrastructure-as-code.

 - Resource Optimization: Demonstrated expertise managing memory, thread/coroutine concurrency, connection pooling, and payload optimization for high-throughput, latency-sensitive workloads.

 - AI Expectations:
   
   - AI-Assisted Development: Hands-on daily use of AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate design, implementation, testing, and code review.
   
   - Critical Evaluation: Ability to critically assess AI-generated code and outputs for correctness, security, and performance before it reaches production.
   
   - Applied AI/ML Literacy: Working understanding of how LLMs and ML models behave in production (latency, cost, failure modes) sufficient to reason about AI-driven components in a backend system.
     




IT’S A BONUS IF YOU HAVE…

 - Identity Verification: Experience with IDV (Identity Verification), KYC systems, or integrating with biometric liveness/anti-spoofing and document-authenticity engines.

 - Workflow & Orchestration: Familiarity with durable workflow engines (Temporal, Cadence, or equivalent) for coordinating long-running, multi-service processes.

 - ML Integration: Experience serving or integrating ML models into back-end services (e.g., Deep Java Library, PyTorch, ONNX, or TensorFlow) and orchestrating third-party vendor APIs.

 - Observability & Ops: Experience with modern observability tooling (metrics, logs, and distributed tracing via OpenTelemetry) and running multi-region production services.
